mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO content_file_mapping(content_type, content_id, file_id, sort_order) VALUES
(#{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{fileId}, #{idx})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_file_mapping WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.file_ids AS file_ids FROM ${table} t WHERE t.file_ids IS NOT NULL AND t.file_ids <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_file_mapping m WHERE m.content_type = #{contentType} AND m.content_id = t.id ) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT t.id AS id, t.file_ids AS file_ids FROM ${table} t WHERE t.file_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileId}, '%')
